verses.text: Den e bring me back di way of di outer gate of di sanctuary, wey face toward di east, and e dey shut.
Di Lord talk to me, “Dis gate go dey shut. E no go dey opened, and no man go enter by am, because di Lord, di God of Israel, don enter by am. Therefore e go dey shut.
As for di prince, e go sit inside am as prince to eat bread before di Lord. E go enter by di way of di porch of di gate, and go go out by di way of am.”
Den e bring me di way of di north gate before di temple. I look, and see, di glory of di Lord fill di Lord house. I fall on my face.

Di Lord talk to me, “Son of man, mark well, and see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all wey I talk to you concerning all di ordinances of di Lord house, and all di laws of am. Mark well di entrance of di temple, with every exit of di sanctuary.
You go talk to di rebels, even to di house of Israel, ‘Di Lord God talk like dis: House of Israel, make una enough of all una abominations,

in that una don bring in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to dey for my sanctuary, to profane am, even my house, when una offer my bread, di fat and di blood. Dem don break my covenant, adding to all una abominations.
Una no keep di charge of my holy things, but una don set keepers of my charge for my sanctuary for yourselves.
Di Lord God talk like dis: No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, go enter into my sanctuary, even any foreigner wey dey among di children of Israel.
But di Levites wey go far from me, when Israel go astray, wey go astray from me after dem idols, dem go bear dem iniquity.

Yet dem go be ministers for my sanctuary, as officers over di gates of di house, and ministers of di house. Dem go slaughter di burnt offering and di sacrifice for di people, and dem go stand before dem to minister to dem.

Because dem minister to dem before dem idols, and become stumbling block of iniquity to di house of Israel, therefore I don lift up my hand against dem,’ talk di Lord God, ‘and dem go bear dem iniquity.

Dem no go come near to me, to execute di office of priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, to di things wey dey most holy. But dem go bear dem shame, and dem abominations wey dem don commit.
Yet I go make dem keepers of di charge of di house, for all di service of am, and for all wey go dey done inside am.

But di priests di Levites, di sons of Zadok, wey keep di charge of my sanctuary when di children of Israel go astray from me, dem go come near to me to minister to me. Dem go stand before me to offer to me di fat and di blood,’ talk di Lord God.
‘Dem go enter into my sanctuary, and dem go come near to my table, to minister to me, and dem go keep my charge.
E go be say when dem enter di gates of di inner court, dem go dey clothed with linen garments. No wool go come on dem, while dem dey minister for di gates of di inner court, and within.
Dem go get linen turbans on dem heads, and dem go get linen trousers on dem loins. Dem no go gird demselves with anything wey cause sweat.

When dem go out into di outer court, even into di outer court to di people, dem go put off dem garments wherein dem minister, and lay dem in di holy chambers, and put on other garments, so that dem no go sanctify di people with dem garments.
Dem no go shave dem heads, nor allow dem locks to grow long. Dem go only trim dem heads.
Neither any priest go drink wine, when dem enter into di inner court.
Dem no go take widow or divorced woman for wife. But dem go take virgins of di offspring of di house of Israel, or widow wey be di widow of priest.
Dem go teach my people di difference between di holy and di common, and cause dem to discern between di unclean and di clean.
For controversy dem go stand to judge. Dem go judge am according to my ordinances. Dem go keep my laws and my statutes for all my appointed feasts, and dem go make my Sabbaths holy.
Dem no go go near to dead person to defile demselves, but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister wey never get husband, dem fit defile demselves.
After im cleansing, dem go count for am seven days.
For di day wey e go into di sanctuary, into di inner court, to minister for di sanctuary, e go offer im sin offering,’ talk di Lord God.
‘Dis go be to dem for inheritance: I be dem inheritance. Una go give dem no possession for Israel. I be dem possession.
Dem go eat di meal offering, and di sin offering, and di trespass offering. Every devoted thing for Israel go be dem own.

Di first of all di first fruits of every kind, and every offering of every kind, of all your offerings, go be di priests own. Una go also give to di priest di first of una dough, so that e go cause blessing to rest on your house.
Di priests no go eat of anything wey die by itself or dey torn, whether bird or animal.’”

“Moreover, when una divide di land by lot for inheritance, una go offer one offering to di Lord, one holy portion of di land. Di length go be 25,000 cubits long, and di width 10,000. E go be holy for all im border round about.
Of dis, 500 by 500, square round about, go be for di sanctuary, with 50 cubits round about for open space.
From dis measure you go measure length of 25,000 cubits, and width of 10,000. Inside am go be di sanctuary, wey be most holy place.
E go be holy portion of di land. E go be for di priests, di ministers of di sanctuary, wey come near to minister to di Lord. E go be place for dem houses, and holy place for di sanctuary.
Length of 25,000 cubits, and width of 10,000, go belong to di Levites, di ministers of di house, for dem own possession, for 20 chambers.
You go appoint di possession of di city 5,000 wide, and 25,000 long, side by side with di holy offering. E go be for di whole house of Israel.

Di prince go get im portion on di one side and on di other side of di holy offering and di possession of di city, in front of di holy offering and in front of di possession of di city, on di west side westward, and on di east side eastward. Di length go be side by side with one of di portions, from di west border to di east border.
Di land go be im possession in Israel. My princes no go oppress my people any more, but dem go give di land to di house of Israel according to dem tribes.”
Di Lord God talk like dis: “Enough, una princes of Israel! Remove violence and plunder, and execute justice and righteousness. Take away una exactions from my people,” talk di Lord God.
“Una go get just balances, and just ephah, and just bath.
Di ephah and di bath go be of one measure, so that di bath go contain di tenth part of one homer, and di ephah di tenth part of one homer. Di measure of dem go be after di homer.
Di shekel go be 20 gerahs. 20 shekels, 25 shekels, and 15 shekels go be una mina.
Dis na di offering wey una go offer: di sixth part of one ephah from one homer of wheat, and una go give di sixth part of one ephah from one homer of barley.
Di set portion of oil, of di bath of oil, na di tenth part of one bath out of di cor, wey be ten baths, or one homer, because ten baths make one homer.
One lamb out of di flock, out of 200, from di well-watered pastures of Israel, for meal offering, and for burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for dem,” talk di Lord God.
“All di people of di land go give dis offering to di prince for Israel.

E go be di prince duty to give di burnt offerings, and di meal offerings, and di drink offerings, for di feasts, and for di new moons, and for di Sabbaths, for all di appointed feasts of di house of Israel. E go prepare di sin offering, and di meal offering, and di burnt offering, and di peace offerings, to make atonement for di house of Israel.”
Di Lord God talk like dis: “For di first month, for di first day of di month, you go take young bull without blemish, and cleanse di sanctuary.
Di priest go take some of di blood of di sin offering, and put am on di door posts of di house, and on di four corners of di ledge of di altar, and on di posts of di gate of di inner court.
So you go do on di seventh day of di month for everyone wey go astray, and for am wey dey simple. So una go make atonement for di house.
For di first month, for di 14th day of di month, una go get di Passover, feast of seven days. Unleavened bread go dey eaten.
For dat day di prince go prepare for imself and for all di people of di land bull for sin offering.
For di seven days of di feast e go prepare burnt offering to di Lord, seven bulls and seven rams without blemish daily di seven days, and male goat daily for sin offering.
E go prepare meal offering, one ephah for bull, and one ephah for ram, and one hin of oil for ephah.

For di seventh month, for di 15th day of di month, for di feast, e go do di same di seven days, according to di sin offering, according to di burnt offering, and according to di meal offering, and according to di oil.”
“Di Lord God talk like dis: Di gate of di inner court wey face toward di east go dey shut di six working days, but on di Sabbath e go dey opened, and for di day of di new moon e go dey opened.

Di prince go enter by di way of di porch of di gate from outside, and go stand by di post of di gate. Di priests go prepare im burnt offering and im peace offerings, and e go worship for di threshold of di gate. Den e go go out, but di gate no go dey shut until evening.
Di people of di land go also worship at di door of dat gate before di Lord for di Sabbaths and for di new moons.
Di burnt offering wey di prince go offer to di Lord for di Sabbath day go be six lambs without blemish and ram without blemish.
Di meal offering go be one ephah for ram, and di meal offering for di lambs as e go dey able to give, and one hin of oil to di ephah.
For di day of di new moon e go be young bull without blemish, and six lambs and ram. Dem go be without blemish.
E go prepare meal offering, one ephah for bull, and one ephah for ram, and for di lambs according as e dey able, and one hin of oil to di ephah.
When di prince go enter, e go go in by di way of di porch of di gate, and e go go out by di same way.

But when di people of di land go come before di Lord for di appointed feasts, im wey enter by di way of di north gate to worship go go out by di way of di south gate, and im wey enter by di way of di south gate go go out by di way of di north gate. E no go return by di way of di gate where e come in, but go go out straight before am.
Di prince go go in among dem when dem go in, and when dem go out, e go go out.
For di feasts and for di appointed feasts di meal offering go be one ephah for bull, and one ephah for ram, and for di lambs as e dey able to give, and one hin of oil to di ephah.

When di prince go prepare freewill offering, burnt offering or peace offerings as freewill offering to di Lord, den dem go open for am di gate wey face toward di east, and e go prepare im burnt offering and im peace offerings, as e do for di Sabbath day. Den e go go out, and after im going out di gate go dey shut.
You go daily prepare burnt offering to di Lord of one lamb of di first year without blemish. Morning by morning you go prepare am.

You go prepare meal offering with am morning by morning, di sixth part of one ephah, and di third part of one hin of oil, to moisten di fine flour, meal offering to di Lord continually by perpetual ordinance.
Dem go prepare di lamb, and di meal offering, and di oil, morning by morning, for continual burnt offering.”
Di Lord God talk like dis: “If di prince give gift to any of im sons, e na im inheritance. E go belong to im sons. E na dem possession by inheritance.
But if e give gift out of im inheritance to one of im servants, e go be im own to di year of liberty. Den e go return to di prince. But as for im inheritance, e go belong to im sons.

Moreover di prince no go take from di people inheritance, to thrust dem out of dem possession. E go give inheritance to im sons out of im own possession, so that my people go no dey scattered, everyone from im possession.”
Den e bring me through di entry, wey dey di side of di gate, into di holy chambers for di priests, wey face toward di north. See, place dey dere for di two sides westward.

E talk to me, “Dis na di place where di priests go boil di trespass offering and di sin offering, and where dem go bake di meal offering, so that dem no go carry dem out into di outer court, to sanctify di people.”
Den e bring me out into di outer court, and cause me to pass by di four corners of di court. See, for every corner of di court dey another court.
For di four corners of di court dey enclosed courts, 40 cubits long and 30 wide. Di four of dem get one measure.
Row of masonry dey round about inside dem, round about di four of dem, and kitchens dey made under di rows round about.
Den e talk to me, “Dis na di kitchens, where di ministers of di house go boil di sacrifices of di people.”

Den e bring me again to di door of di temple. See, water dey flow from under di threshold of di temple toward di east, because di temple face toward di east. Di water dey come down from under, from di right side of di temple, for di south of di altar.
Den e bring me out by di way of di north gate, and lead me about by di way outside to di outer gate, by di way of di gate wey face toward di east. See, water dey trickle out from di south side.
When di man go out toward di east with di line for im hand, e measure 1,000 cubits, and e cause me to pass through di waters, waters wey reach to di ankles.
Again e measure 1,000, and cause me to pass through di waters, waters wey reach to di knees. Again e measure 1,000, and cause me to pass through, waters wey reach to di waist.
Again e measure 1,000, and e be river wey I no fit pass through, because di waters don rise, waters to swim in, river wey no fit dey passed through.
E talk to me, “Son of man, you don see dis?” Den e lead me, and cause me to return to di bank of di river.
When I return, see, for di bank of di river dey very many trees on di one side and on di other side.
Den e talk to me, “Dis waters flow toward di eastern region, and go down into di Arabah. Dem go enter into di sea. Into di sea wey dem cause to go out, di waters go dey healed.

E go happen say every living creature wey swarm, wherever di rivers go, go live. Dey go be very great multitude of fish, because dis waters don go dere, and di waters of di sea don dey healed, and everything go live wherever di river go.
E go happen say fishermen go stand by am from Engedi even to Eneglaim. Dem go be place for di spreading of nets. Dem fish go be according to dem kinds, like di fish of di great sea, very many.
But im swamps and im marshes no go dey healed. Dem go dey given up to salt.

By di river on im bank, on dis side and on dat side, go grow every tree for food, wey im leaf no go wither, neither im fruit fail. E go bring forth new fruit every month, because im waters flow from di sanctuary. Im fruit go be for food, and im leaf for healing.”
Di Lord God talk like dis: “Dis na di border by which una go divide di land for inheritance according to di 12 tribes of Israel. Joseph go get two portions.
Una go inherit am, one as well as another, wey I lift up my hand to give to una fathers. Dis land go fall to una for inheritance.
Dis go be di border of di land: on di north side, from di great sea, by di way of Hethlon, to di entrance of Zedad,
Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (wey dey between di border of Damascus and di border of Hamath), Hazer Hatticon, wey dey by di border of Hauran.
So di border go be from di sea to Hazar Enan, di border of Damascus, with di border of Hamath to di north. Dis na di north side.
On di east side, between Hauran and Damascus and Gilead, and di land of Israel, di Jordan go be di border to di eastern sea, and una go measure to Tamar. Dis na di east side.
On di south side southward, from Tamar to di waters of Meribath Kadesh, to di brook of Egypt, to di great sea. Dis na di south side southward.
Di west side go be di great sea, from di border to di entrance of Hamath. Dis na di west side.
So una go divide dis land to una according to di tribes of Israel.

E go happen say una go divide am by lot for inheritance to una, and to di foreigners wey dwell among una, wey don bear children among una. Dem go be to una as native-born among di children of Israel. Dem go have inheritance with una among di tribes of Israel.
For wetin tribe di foreigner dwell, dere una go give am im inheritance,” talk di Lord God.

Now dis na di names of di tribes. From di north end, by di way of Hethlon to di entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan, di border of Damascus, northward, by Hamath, dem go get di east side and di west side: Dan, one portion.
By di border of Dan, from di east side to di west side: Asher, one portion.
By di border of Asher, from di east side even to di west side: Naphtali, one portion.
By di border of Naphtali, from di east side to di west side: Manasseh, one portion.
By di border of Manasseh, from di east side to di west side: Ephraim, one portion.
By di border of Ephraim, from di east side even to di west side: Reuben, one portion.
By di border of Reuben, from di east side to di west side: Judah, one portion.

By di border of Judah, from di east side to di west side, go be di offering wey una go offer, 25,000 cubits wide, and in length like one of di portions, from di east side to di west side, with di sanctuary inside am.
Di offering wey una go offer to di Lord go be 25,000 cubits long, and 10,000 wide.

Dis go be di holy offering for dem, for di priests, toward di north 25,000 cubits, and toward di west 10,000 wide, and toward di east 10,000 wide, and toward di south 25,000 long. Di sanctuary of di Lord go dey inside am.
E go be for di priests wey dey sanctified, wey be di sons of Zadok, wey don keep my charge, wey no go astray when di children of Israel go astray, as di Levites go astray.
E go be to dem offering from di offering of di land, most holy, by di border of di Levites.
Alongside di border of di priests, di Levites go get 25,000 cubits long, and 10,000 wide. Di whole length go be 25,000, and di width 10,000.
Dem no go sell any of am, nor exchange am, nor di firstfruits of di land go dey alienated, because e dey holy to di Lord.
Di 5,000 wey remain for di width, over against di 25,000, go be common land for di city, for dwelling and for open land. Di city go dey for di middle of am.
Dis go be im measures: di north side 4,500, and di south side 4,500, and on di east side 4,500, and di west side 4,500.
Di city go get open land: toward di north 250, and toward di south 250, and toward di east 250, and toward di west 250.

Di rest of di length, side by side with di holy offering, go be 10,000 toward di east, and 10,000 toward di west. E go be side by side with di holy offering. Im produce go be food for dem wey serve di city.
Dem wey serve di city, out of all di tribes of Israel, go cultivate am.
Di whole offering go be 25,000 by 25,000. You go offer di holy offering foursquare, with di possession of di city.

Di rest go be di prince own, on di one side and on di other side of di holy offering and of di possession of di city, in front of di 25,000 of di offering toward di east border, and westward in front of di 25,000 toward di west border, side by side with di portions. E go be di prince own. Di holy offering and di sanctuary of di house go dey inside am.

Moreover from di possession of di Levites and from di possession of di city, wey dey in di middle of wetin belong to di prince, between di border of Judah and di border of Benjamin, e go be di prince own.
As for di rest of di tribes: from di east side to di west side, Benjamin, one portion.
By di border of Benjamin, from di east side to di west side: Simeon, one portion.
By di border of Simeon, from di east side to di west side: Issachar, one portion.
By di border of Issachar, from di east side to di west side: Zebulun, one portion.
By di border of Zebulun, from di east side to di west side: Gad, one portion.
By di border of Gad, on di south side southward, di border go be from Tamar to di waters of Meribath Kadesh, to di brook of Egypt, to di great sea.
“Dis na di land wey una go divide by lot for inheritance to di tribes of Israel, and dis na dem portions,” talk di Lord God.
“Dis na di exits of di city: from di north side, 4,500 cubits by measure,
di gates of di city go be after di names of di tribes of Israel, three gates northward: di gate of Reuben, one, di gate of Judah, one, di gate of Levi, one.
On di east side, 4,500 cubits, and three gates: even di gate of Joseph, one, di gate of Benjamin, one, di gate of Dan, one.
On di south side, 4,500 cubits by measure, and three gates: di gate of Simeon, one, di gate of Issachar, one, di gate of Zebulun, one.
On di west side, 4,500 cubits, with dem three gates: di gate of Gad, one, di gate of Asher, one, di gate of Naphtali, one.
Round about 18,000 cubits. Di name of di city from dat day go be, ‘Di Lord dey dere.’”
